### Sample adequacy
Only 1 field was scanned with 1 white cell counted and 14 red cells and 0 platelets estimated. This is well below the 100 cells needed for a reliable differential and below the 20-cell threshold for comparison to ranges. The differential below is therefore only indicative and the count is too small for range interpretation.

### Differential
Automated count: 1 neutrophil (100% of 1 white cell). No comparison to reference ranges is made due to the low cell number; a larger sample is needed.

### Review list
The automated review queue contains 1 cell. Flagged for priority opening:
- Cell 1 (neutrophil, confidence 0.96) — single cell on slide marked for review, agreement on second opinion but requires human confirmation.
No change to counts was made; second opinion is for highlighting, not correction.

### Limits
Second opinion is a generalist (65% on single cells, weak on IG/erythroblasts) vs classifier 97.6%; disagreements prompt human review only. Red cells undercounted on crowded fields — count indicative. Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; lab ranges prevail.
